output_shape: JSON object {typos: [{value, correction, flavour, rationale}, ...]}; empty list means 'no typos'.
ambiguous_scoring_rule: v3 carries an ``ambiguous_values`` list per column (the union of v2 cell-level ambiguous gold rows). Predictions on ambiguous values are removed from BOTH the predicted and gold sets before scoring -- credited neither true positive nor false positive.
correction_mismatch_rule: A predicted (value, correction) pair where ``value`` matches gold but ``correction`` does not is counted as BOTH a false positive AND a false negative.
normalisation: Match key uses case-folding + collapsed whitespace; otherwise verbatim.
